description: Store the person's own CV, as text, for an account that has no CV yet. Pass the CV they supplied verbatim — text they pasted, or the content of a CV file they gave you. Never compose, summarise or embellish a CV: it is stored as theirs and its work history is recorded as their own words. If they have no CV, they upload or write one on the website instead. Between 100 and 30000 characters. Refused when the account already has a CV; it is replaced on the website. Returns the profile values the CV suggests (specializations, seniorities, skills) for the person to confirm. Once the work history has been read in the background, skills found in it are added to the profile's skills, as with an upload on the website.
name: add_cv
title: Add my CV
